slides.headline: October 31, 1875: a boy was born in Gujarat who would later talk over 500 separate kingdoms into joining one country.
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, independent India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister, was born October 31, 1875
slides.body: He is credited with the political integration of more than 500 princely states into the Indian Union after independence - a negotiation that determined the literal shape of the country on a map.

slides.headline: India has observed October 31 as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas - National Unity Day - since 2014.
slides.body: 2026 marks his 151st birth anniversary and closes a two-year nationwide commemorative programme that began with his 150th anniversary in 2025, centred at the Statue of Unity in Gujarat.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat is still the country Patel's negotiations assembled piece by piece.
slides.body: Nearly 80 years on, the map he helped draw through persuasion rather than conquest is the same one the country is still building on.
